fusions.name: Cloud of Cuts
fusions.desc: A cone of cuts that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you. Its damage rises 8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%).

fusions.name: Gnawing Pass
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 8 damage, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Stripping Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that gnaws an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Rising Appetite
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
